verdict.rationale: Direct probes confirm a live llms.txt at docs.morphllm.com, with a structured header covering the base URL and OpenAI compatibility. Docs pages are also served as raw Markdown (.md), and each page includes a documentation index pointing agents back to llms.txt. Many cited doc URLs are .md endpoints, which shows agent-readable docs exist across the site. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents actually consuming these docs, evidence of an expanded llms-full.txt variant.
